scoring: 0 absent, 1 severe failure, 2 major gap, 3 usable with limitations, 4 meets brief, 5 exceeds brief with specific evidence

dimensions.brief_coverage: Four named modules, three requested states, all labels present and meaningful
dimensions.native_editability: Native text and native geometry in actual PPTX; no flattening into a slide image
dimensions.identity_structure: One-to-one forced names, correct transition destinations and declared duration, no duplicate local IDs
dimensions.static_readability: Visual inspection of all exported slides for occlusion, clipping, wrapping and contrast
dimensions.native_motion: PowerPoint playback recording with app/version and SHA256 of exact deck
dimensions.creative_quality: Subjective reviewer assessment of visual hierarchy, composition and purposeful motion; motion remains unscored without playback

rules: Unobservable dimensions are null, never zero or full marks.
Report objective counts separately from subjective scores.
No aggregate success score while native_motion is null.
No causal claim about model improvement from one hand-authored example.
Use the same prompt, plan and renderer settings when comparing patcher revisions.
